arch.LOB.desc: Lobs in an arc and splashes. Cannot hit air.
arch.MELEE.desc: Strikes several nearby enemies at once.
arch.ZONE.desc: Keeps affecting every enemy in range.
arch.BEAM.desc: Grows stronger the longer it holds a target.
arch.SUMMON.desc: Sends summons onto the path to hold enemies.
arch.WALL.desc: Stands on the path and blocks enemies.
arch.SPECIAL.desc: Fights in a way all its own.
battle.bossWings: The queen sprouted wings! Hit the sky
battle.menu.title: Taking a break
battle.tip.air: Bring a plant that can hit the sky
battle.tip.armor: Try Thorn synergy to strip armor
battle.tip.fast: Slow or bind the fast ones to catch them
battle.tip.split: Area attacks work well on splitting enemies
battle.tip.boss: Bosses take a long fight. Save your blooms for them
battle.tip.generic: Gather and upgrade plants at the chokepoints
stage.1-1.desc: Little aphids march in a line. Plant beside the path and hold the waves.
stage.1-2.desc: Fast beetles charge in. Fertile soil makes plants a bit stronger.
stage.1-3.desc: Armored snails appear. Strip their armor with Thorn plants.
stage.1-4.desc: Two entrances merge. Guard the junction.
stage.1-5.desc: A long path and a pond. Bring water-only plants too.
stage.1-6.desc: The queen spawns young and grows wings halfway. Be ready for the sky.
enemy.E02.tip: Slow and tough. The shell cracks at half health.
enemy.E03.tip: Very fast. Stop it with slows and binds.
enemy.E04.tip: Splits into three segments. Weak to area attacks.
enemy.E05.tip: Sometimes rolls up. Immune to slows while rolling.
enemy.B1.tip: Spawns young and sprouts wings at half health.

howto.title: How to Play
howto.grow.title: Grow
howto.grow.body: Plant seeds and keep water, food, hygiene and mood up. Better care means faster, stronger plants.
howto.defend.title: Defend
howto.defend.body: Young plants can fight! Plant them by the path to stop the Wilt. Each one that reaches the roots costs a heart.
howto.collect.title: Collect
howto.collect.body: Wins bring seeds, nutrients and compost. Plant new seeds to grow a stronger garden.
howto.loop: Grow → Defend → Collect → Grow again. That is the whole loop.
battle.flow.guide: ① Pick a card below  ② Tap grass by the path  ③ Stop enemies on the arrow road
